2) Travel: two of our infra folks (incl. Jacob) are traveling for customer meetings next week and will be offline intermittently.

Given both constraints, we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference demo for the immediate window and move it to a later cycle. Can we pause the active scheduling for now? I don't want you preparing detailed runbooks this week only for us to miss the key stakeholders.

Please keep us on a quarterly check-in cadence; I'll reach back out once the sprint settles (likely late Oct / early Nov) with proposed slots. Apologies — we should have flagged the sprint earlier.

Thanks for understanding,
